observations: White baby cot with heart-shaped cutouts on the end panels.
Side rails consist of vertical slats.
The mattress base is made of unfinished wooden slats, visible in photo 2.
The entire unit is wrapped in clear plastic stretch film.
Small decorative stickers are applied to the end panels.
No brand names or model numbers are visible on the frame.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap obscures the surface texture and joint repairs; it only proves the item has been packaged.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 show the structure and design of a standard infant cot.

risks.risk: Surface damage or poor paint finish hidden by the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photos of the panels with the plastic wrap removed.
risks.if_unproven: as having significant cosmetic wear and scratches.

risks.proof: A photo of the mattress alongside the cot.
A clear photo of all assembly hardware and any wheels.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a hardware replacement kit.

proof_requests: Photos of the cot with the plastic wrap removed to inspect the finish.
Photo of the mattress if it is included in the sale.
Photo of the assembly bolts and any wheels/casters.
response.reason: The item is a standard baby cot. It can be priced as a used frame in its worst-case cosmetic condition.
